name: Corr2Cause
description: Corr2Cause is a large-scale benchmark dataset designed to test the pure causal inference skills of large language models by determining causal relationships from sets of correlational statements. It challenges LLMs to perform causal inference beyond empirical knowledge and evaluates their generalizability in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings.
reputation: A relatively new benchmark with limited but growing attention, mainly used in recent causal-inference-focused LLM evaluation work.
notes: Focuses on pure causal inference skills; models perform close to random without fine-tuning and struggle with out-of-distribution generalization.
